meta.name: Puzzle 04 — Silence the Blinker
meta.description: SOLO PUZZLE. A Blinker oscillates at the center. Goal: destroy it in 1 move using a Block. Teaches that placing adjacent still lifes can kill oscillators via overcrowding.
meta.rules: Solo mode. Prompt: 'Destroy the oscillator in 1 move.' Win check: 0 live cells at end.
questions: Does a Block placed adjacent to a Blinker actually sterilize it?
Does ghost preview make the correct placement obvious?

moves.note: Player drops a Block overlapping the left end of the blinker. placePattern skips already-alive cells, so this adds cells above and left of the blinker.
4 Conway steps to let the interaction play out.
